To Whom It May Concern,  

I’ve collaborated daily with Olivia Chen over the past two years at a mid-sized adtech startup, where she’s been a critical part of our machine learning team. She’s consistently delivered high-impact work while maintaining a collaborative, no-nonsense approach to problem-solving.  

Olivia’s strength lies in her ability to balance technical depth with pragmatic execution. She owns our recommendation systems, which drive 25% of our platform’s user engagement, and has reduced model inference costs by 18% through cloud cost optimization strategies. Her work with PyTorch and TensorFlow has been instrumental in scaling our A/B testing frameworks, cutting deployment cycles by 30% while improving model accuracy. She’s also spearheaded MLOps integration using MLflow and W&B, reducing production bottlenecks and enabling cross-team reproducibility.  

A standout example came when she rearchitected our model deployment pipeline, transitioning from monolithic to microservices-based workflows. This shift allowed us to roll out new features 40% faster and handle 5x more traffic without downtime. She mentored junior engineers through this process, ensuring best practices became part of our standard operating procedure.  

Olivia’s work ethic is uncompromising—she’ll stay late to debug a production issue or refactor legacy code to improve maintainability. Her curiosity and attention to detail ensure her solutions are both innovative and sustainable.  

If you’re seeking someone who can deliver measurable results while fostering team growth, Olivia is an exceptional choice.  

— Alex Rivera  
Senior ML Engineer
